title: Trees
description: Keep every team at the event in a binary search tree that stays sorted as you add to it, then count the actions in an auto shaped like the robot's behavior trees. Recursion does the walking.

checkpoints.title: Insert and find
checkpoints.description: TeamTree.insert puts lower team numbers to the left and higher ones to the right (no repeats); contains and size work on any tree.

checkpoints.title: In order
checkpoints.description: TeamTree.inOrder returns every team, lowest number first, by visiting left, node, right.

checkpoints.title: Height
checkpoints.description: TeamTree.height counts the nodes on the longest path from the root down: 0 for an empty tree, 1 for one team.

checkpoints.title: An auto tree
checkpoints.description: AutoNode.countActions counts the nodes with no children, and AutoNode.depth measures the longest path down, in a tree where a node can have any number of children.
